name: viperwow-awesome-marketplace
description: Curated third-party skills, plugins, hooks and MCP servers for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Ponytail 5 makes AI coding agents write the least code that works. Rebuilt from the ground up: 53% less code, 41% faster, 26% cheaper, 45% fewer tokens, and 98% of risky logic ships with a test.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: 98% less context: 315 KB of raw tool output becomes 5.4 KB. Session memory survives compaction, so the agent still knows its files, tasks and your last ask. Works in 17 clients.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: 33.2% fewer input tokens per session, 63.6% fewer response tokens in Elastic's tests, and no measurable quality loss in JetBrains' 86-task A/B. Works with 30+ agents.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: 15 skills that make your agent work like a disciplined engineer: brainstorm, spec, plan, test first, review. Spec-driven development out of the box.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Stop a bad agent habit in one command: /hookify Warn me when I use rm -rf. No code and no hooks.json, only a markdown rule that you can toggle without a restart.
